key_insight: The paper introduces “distance amplifiers” that modularly boost both code distance and certified circuit-level protection in qLDPC quantum memories, with exact multiplicative scaling under stated conditions.
engineering_relevance: This provides a systematic way to build larger, more fault-tolerant quantum memories from smaller components while keeping syndrome-extraction circuits certifiable.
method: Tensor a base qLDPC code with an amplifier code to increase distance.
Adapt syndrome-extraction circuits with gate ordering and flag qubits to suppress correlated faults.
Use a recursive fault-response certificate to lower-bound circuit distance and certify amplification step by step.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an explicit construction where four flagged [[4,2,2]] amplification steps applied to a [[18,4,4]] seed yield a [[13320,64,64]] code with circuit distance d_circ ≥ 48 and check weights w ≤ 14.
watch_item: The multiplicative distance guarantee depends on specific circuit design choices and amplifier conditions, so implementation details must be carefully verified for each new construction.
paper_title: Ultra-high-distance quantum memories from amplified qLDPC codes
